title: Articles L–LV · On remaining aspects of the third species — Christ as teacher, intercessor and head of the Church; and on the contemplation of Mary and the saints

blocks.s: [Articles L–LV complete the third species of contemplation by considering: Christ as teacher of saving truth; Christ as high priest and perpetual intercessor; Christ as head of the mystical body, giving life and grace to all his members; the contemplation of the Blessed Virgin Mary as the most perfect created image of the Incarnate Word and the model of the contemplative soul; and the contemplation of the saints in glory, who mirror most perfectly the perfections of Christ and of the Deity, and whose intercession the contemplator is to seek continually.]
